rules.title: Immutable design-system source
rules.description: The consumer records a semantic version and immutable 40-character source commit.

rules.title: Generated asset integrity
rules.description: Committed shared assets and helpers match the pinned design-system source.

rules.title: Shared global header
rules.description: Every product route or state uses the shared global-header and identity contract.

rules.title: Canonical owned-site directory
rules.description: The Sites control exposes all three canonical owned sites and the correct current state.

rules.title: Sites and compact-menu keyboard contract
rules.description: Arrow keys, Escape, close behavior, and focus restoration follow the shared controller contract.

rules.title: No adopted primitive fallback duplication
rules.description: Once a shared primitive is adopted and validated, equivalent product structural declarations are removed.

rules.title: Shared native-dialog shell
rules.description: Matching native confirmation dialogs use the shared dialog structure while product logic remains local.

rules.title: Dialog accessibility and recovery
rules.description: Dialogs have accessible names and descriptions, reachable actions, cancellation, and focus restoration.

rules.title: Minimum-width containment
rules.description: The document has no horizontal overflow at the supported 320-pixel viewport.

rules.title: Actual 200 percent browser zoom
rules.description: Core product routes remain usable at actual 200 percent browser zoom.

rules.title: Keyboard and focus behavior
rules.description: Essential controls remain keyboard reachable with visible focus and expected restoration.

rules.title: Forced colors and assistive technology
rules.description: Core workflows receive a real forced-colors and assistive-technology review.

rules.title: Written error recovery
rules.description: Meaningful errors include a written reason and a recovery action.

rules.title: State does not rely on color alone
rules.description: Status and analytical meaning remain understandable through text, labels, or shape without color alone.

rules.title: Product ownership boundary
rules.description: Product state, copy, workflows, measurement, storage, and application logic remain in the product repository.

rules.title: Immutable shared workflow pin
rules.description: Consumer synchronization calls the reusable design-system workflow by immutable commit and keeps validation local.

rules.title: Product conformance pipeline
rules.description: Product CI runs design-system integration checks, rendered-state audits, and relevant build or application tests.

rules.title: Performance and bundle baseline
rules.description: The product records reviewed bundle and user-experience performance baselines.
